title: Magazine clipping: photos of NICAP director Donald Keyhoe and Dr. Edward Condon
description: Clipped magazine page (numbered 3) with two halftone portrait photos of public figures, overprinted with a coarse screen pattern. The top photo shows a man speaking while holding papers, captioned "He is convinced UFO's are intelligently controlled from Outer Space—Donald E. Keyoe, director of the National Investigations Committee on Aerial Phenomena." The bottom close-up of a man in glasses is captioned "He will try to find out—Dr. Edward Condon, former head of the National Bureau of Standards and recently named director of the Air Force-sponsored civilian investigation of UFO's with headquarters at the University of Colorado in Boulder."
